method: Static reverse engineering only. atomscan and cleave facts run for all three original files; Rizin, PE parsing, AutoIt extraction, RC4 decryption and CIL decoding used. No sample executed.

samples.identification: Windows x86 NtHook/Beep bootkit installer (2012 build timestamps)
evidence: Outer main 0x401d40 checks VM processes/files and uses alternate paths before installation. 0x401910 writes the embedded driver; 0x4027e2 enables SeLoadDriverPrivilege and 0x4027f7 invokes resolved ZwLoadDriver. SCM fallback at 0x401060 uses SERVICE_KERNEL_DRIVER with demand start, not proof of automatic startup.
Embedded PE at file offset 0xb840: entry 0x8003e reaches DriverEntry 0x155de, which calls initialization 0x14fd4. This initializes syscall interception and the filename exclusion list.

0x114f6 derives NtQueryDirectoryFile index from ntdll and reads its SSDT entry. Interceptor 0x13b34 redirects it to 0x13228. That calls the original operation, tests names against the exclusion list, and removes records by compacting the linked directory buffer. Hidden names are registered by 0x12114; names are corroboration, not required detection strings.

0x12dde reads sector 0 and writes driver/loader material to raw disk through 0x12cb0 (IoBuildAsynchronousFsdRequest/IofCallDriver). It copies the replacement boot code into the original sector buffer and writes it back. Embedded real-mode code at VA 0x187d0 saves and replaces IVT INT13h, relocates itself, reads further sectors and patches read boot code with a far call to its relocated payload.

TerminateProcess xrefs in the outer image are 0x4032ac and 0x404462, both runtime error paths. Security names plus that import do not demonstrate killing security software. An HTTP URL containing mac=0-0-0-0 on the VM branch also does not demonstrate actual hardware-address theft or repeated C2 beaconing.
samples.limits: No evidence supports the RedLine or Rhadamanthys family names in the collector filename. Generic bootkit identification is intentional.
samples.marker_line: NtHook bootkit: add BIOS hook; remove API-only hostile claims

samples.identification: SciTE-masquerading AutoIt RunPE loader carrying a .NET RAT
evidence: PE version metadata claims SciTE 1.75/Neil Hodgson/SciTE.EXE, while native code implements the AutoIt runtime and SCRIPT_DATUM contains an EA06 compiled script. This is not a text editor.

Decoded SCRIPT_DATUM using the AutoIt EA06 format after its randomized header. Script has flattened constant-state dispatch and decimal character lists decoded by N3433YIANJ using ChrW. Following the state transitions establishes the live paths rather than relying on dead GUI junk.

Y3235YFQ reads its own bytes and splits the serialized resource fields. Fields select ciphertext, key, Framework host, startup mode 2 and watchdog 1. R3238KGBJ decrypts the payload through A35VCL (CryptoAPI RC4, MD5-derived key) and passes it to K3333TZQT.

K3333TZQT creates the configured process suspended (CreateProcessW flags 0x08000004), validates and maps the embedded PE, writes it into the child, changes thread context and resumes the thread. Host cvtres paths are rewritten to RegAsm for the recognized Framework versions.
R3231YPYIK mode 2 copies itself under common application data, writes an HKCU Run value, marks the copy +SH and relaunches hidden. Watchdog I3332GIR monitors the injected process and recreates it.

Decrypted first field is a 24064-byte .NET assembly. CIL .cctor configures a remote host and TCP port; OK.ko starts network receive and keylogger workers. OK.RC receives socket frames and dispatches them through OK.Ind. Commands include remote execution and reflective plugin loading. kl.WRK polls GetAsyncKeyState; stored keylog data is returned through OK.Send/Socket.Send. The decoy field decrypts to a music-mix text notice.
samples.limits: RAT behavior is established from decrypted IL; no exact family attribution is required. Config detections describe a recognized serializer plus deceptive AutoIt context, not a direct observation of process injection.
samples.marker_line: AutoIt RAT loader: bind config to masquerade; generalize fields

samples.identification: Big Fish OpenBSD shared-memory/multicast local root exploit source
samples.provenance: The source identifies big-fish.c and OpenBSD 7.9. The mechanism agrees with public research at https://calif.io/research/big-fish; this is exploit/PoC code, not a stealer or covert implant.
evidence: main calls do_wrap, which banks shmat attachment records, munmaps the views and amplifies the signed counter through fork. A positive attachment count aborts; IPC_RMID then frees an object while stale records remain.

race_once repeatedly attaches/detaches and reuses a shared-memory slot. A helper retains the dangling mapping. Allocator statistics guide poll/readv/multicast grooming; invalid-descriptor readv copies controlled iovec arrays into kernel allocations.

stage_carriers/post_iov_holder put kernel/user addresses into both iov_base and iov_len. A fault through the dangling mapping corrupts multicast membership bookkeeping. Closing the target socket walks forged membership entries, decrements the recursive PTE and overwrites an interface callback.

prepare_shell_page supplies machine code that loads p_ucred and writes cr_uid=0, restores the callback and repairs reference accounting. Successful execution verifies euid zero, sets all user/group IDs to zero and execls /bin/sh -p, optionally with caller-supplied command text. This is a concrete kernel-to-root boundary crossing.
samples.limits: Research provenance is retained. MALICIOUS labels the exploit behavior, not its author or a claim that this file has been deployed against victims. Ordinary root-ID setters and shell wrappers were moved to neutral capability homes.
samples.marker_line: Big Fish root exploit: retain exploit traits; relocate neutral APIs

change_summary: Added bootkit detection; relocated ten unsupported intent claims or misplaced observations; corrected URLMon co-occurrence severity; generalized serialized AutoIt config fields and required deceptive editor context; tightened shell argv matcher to an actual execl shell call.
controls: 18 focused controls passed, plus two existing setresuid fixtures. Bootkit composite precision 7.0. Schema 2/1 observations name literal values, not their inferred startup/watchdog roles. Final original-file scans and final make validate run separately.

verification.original_atomscan_rescans: Completed with exactly 2, 3 and 2 distinct hostile traits respectively. All expected IDs asserted.
verification.focused_controls: 18 positive and near-miss cases plus two existing setresuid workload cases.
